verdict.rationale: Highnote documents a dedicated Test environment, separate from Live, that 'replicates the full functionality of the Live environment' and lets you simulate real-time transactions and compliance scenarios. Its docs also describe 'a test environment that behaves like production' where you can simulate authorizations, refunds, and statements before going live. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of test-vs-live credential and data isolation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox fidelity.
